acceptance_criteria: Skill states default discovery and output paths; canonical workflow/docs/setup use local paths consistently; a baseline scenario covers unspecified new material; existing ignored data is moved without loss or collision; ignore rules match consolidated layout; focused behavior/static checks pass; task-owned tracked changes are committed and Bead closes successfully.
